items.title: A fix release
items.text: 7 fixes, mostly found by checking the last suspicions from the 1.7.1 sweep, and one new linking setting.

items.title: Linking
items.text: A linked server can no longer take the services server's rights by saying it takes SASL logins while services are linked, or by coming in later under the services server's name after a split.

items.title: Linking
items.text: half-done SASL logins are cleaned up when a link drops, instead of being kept forever.

items.title: Web chat
items.text: Pings and empty messages from a web chat client now count towards flood control.

items.title: Web chat
items.text: One IP address can hold at most 16 web chat connections that haven't finished connecting; more are refused (connections through your own proxy are not counted).
